description: Delete a financed invoice registration from the blind anti-fraud registry when the invoice is paid off or withdrawn. Only the registering workspace can delete its token.

caseId.description: Optional CaseSchema.id to release a purchase row from Book.

currency.description: ISO currency code, for example USD or EUR.

purchaseId.description: Optional purchase row id on the case.

token.description: Optional invtok_... blind token to delete.

name: release_financed_invoice
title: Release financed invoice
